caseNameFull: Levy v. Resor, Secretary of the Army
attorneys: Charles Morgan, Jr., Anthony G. Amsterdam, Alan H. Levine and Melvin L. Wulf for petitioner., Solicitor General Gris-wold, Assistant Attorney General Vinson and Beatrice Rosenberg for respondents.

opinions.text:
C. A. 4th Cir. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted. Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
